name: WorldNiche
subtitle: Culture, music & local stories
description:
The world is full of little wonders. WorldNiche helps you find them.

Turn the globe, tap a country, or let curiosity choose your next stop. Explore 195 countries through the small details that make a place its own: a local tradition, a song on the charts, a different point of view.

A LITTLE MORE LOCAL
Discover cultural stories and details from linked sources. Find another thread whenever curiosity strikes, and follow the source to learn more.

A SONG TO BRING HOME
See Apple Music charts for supported countries and open a song in Apple Music. Rankings reflect Apple Music listeners, and availability varies by country.

A NEW POINT OF VIEW
Read recent English-language headlines about each destination, with links to the original coverage.

KEEP A LITTLE OF EVERYWHERE
Save countries to your Journal and add private notes. With an account, your saved places, notes and exploration history sync across your devices. Guest journals stay on your device.

CURIOSITY IS BETTER TOGETHER
Create a profile with Sign in with Apple, share an invitation link, and see which countries your friends have explored. Choose whether to share your own explorations. Your notes and bookmarks stay private.

KEEP ASKING
Ask Niche follow-up questions on devices that support Apple Intelligence. Availability depends on your device, language and Apple Intelligence settings.

Built for iPhone, with native controls, larger text support, and layouts that adapt when you unfold iPhone Duo. Explore without creating an account. An internet connection is needed for fresh discoveries, charts, news and account features.

A country contains many cultures. These discoveries are invitations to ask, never assumptions about a person.
promotionalText: Spin the globe. Find a local story, a new song, or a better question to ask. Keep your discoveries in a private journal and explore alongside friends.
